# Commet Documentation

> B2B SaaS billing platform for Latin America

- Documentation: Guides, SDKs, and references to integrate Commet into your application
  - [Introduction](https://commet.co/docs): Commet is a billing and payments platform for SaaS and AI products.

  - **Quickstart**
  - Node.js: Integrate Commet with Node.js frameworks
    - [Integrate with Next.js](https://commet.co/docs/integrate-with-nextjs.md): Add billing and payments to your Next.js application.
    - [Integrate with Remix](https://commet.co/docs/integrate-with-remix.md): Add billing and payments to your Remix application.
    - [Integrate with Nuxt](https://commet.co/docs/integrate-with-nuxt.md): Add billing and payments to your Nuxt application.
    - [Integrate with SvelteKit](https://commet.co/docs/integrate-with-sveltekit.md): Add billing and payments to your SvelteKit application.
    - [Integrate with Astro](https://commet.co/docs/integrate-with-astro.md): Add billing and payments to your Astro application.
    - [Integrate with Express](https://commet.co/docs/integrate-with-express.md): Add billing and payments to your Express application.
    - [Integrate with Hono](https://commet.co/docs/integrate-with-hono.md): Add billing and payments to your Hono application.
    - [Integrate with Bun](https://commet.co/docs/integrate-with-bun.md): Add billing and payments to your Bun application.
  - Python: Integrate Commet with Python frameworks
    - [Integrate with Python](https://commet.co/docs/integrate-with-python.md): Install and configure the Commet Python SDK.
    - [Integrate with Flask](https://commet.co/docs/integrate-with-flask.md): Add billing and payments to your Flask application.
    - [Integrate with FastAPI](https://commet.co/docs/integrate-with-fastapi.md): Add billing and payments to your FastAPI application.
    - [Integrate with Django](https://commet.co/docs/integrate-with-django.md): Add billing and payments to your Django application.
  - Java: Integrate Commet with Java applications
    - [Integrate with Java](https://commet.co/docs/integrate-with-java.md): Install and configure the Commet Java SDK.
  - Go: Integrate Commet with Go applications
    - [Integrate with Go](https://commet.co/docs/integrate-with-go.md): Add billing and payments to your Go application using net/http.
    - [Integrate with Encore](https://commet.co/docs/integrate-with-encore.md): Add billing and payments to your Encore application.
  - PHP: Integrate Commet with PHP frameworks
    - [Integrate with PHP](https://commet.co/docs/integrate-with-php.md): Install and configure the Commet PHP SDK.
    - [Integrate with Laravel](https://commet.co/docs/integrate-with-laravel.md): Add billing and payments to your Laravel application.
    - [Integrate with Symfony](https://commet.co/docs/integrate-with-symfony.md): Add billing and payments to your Symfony application.

  - **Learn**
  - Customers: Create, manage, and provide self-service portals to your customers
    - [Manage Customers](https://commet.co/docs/manage-customers.md): Create and manage customers using the Commet SDK and dashboard.
    - [Customer Portal](https://commet.co/docs/customer-portal.md): Self-service portal for customers to manage their subscriptions.
  - Plans: Configure pricing plans, features, consumption models, and add-ons
    - [Manage Plans](https://commet.co/docs/create-plans.md): Create and manage pricing plans in Commet that automatically generate subscriptions.
    - [Configure Features](https://commet.co/docs/configure-features.md): Define capabilities with boolean, metered, seat, and quota feature types in Commet.
    - [Consumption Models](https://commet.co/docs/consumption-models.md): Understand the three ways customers consume and pay for features in Commet plans.
    - [Add-ons](https://commet.co/docs/add-ons.md): Offer optional features customers can activate on their subscriptions for an additional price.
    - [Credit Packs](https://commet.co/docs/credit-packs.md): Configure credit packages that customers can purchase from the Commet Customer Portal.
    - [Promo Codes](https://commet.co/docs/promo-codes.md): Create marketing discount codes that customers enter at checkout in Commet.
    - [Plan Groups](https://commet.co/docs/plan-groups.md): Group plans together to enable self-service upgrades and downgrades in the Commet Customer Portal.
    - [Regional Prices](https://commet.co/docs/regional-prices.md): Define local currency pricing for your Commet plans so customers pay in their own currency.
    - [One-Time Payments](https://commet.co/docs/one-time-payments.md): Sell lifetime access or one-time purchases with a single charge and no recurring billing.
    - [Trial Periods](https://commet.co/docs/trial-periods.md): Offer free trials on paid plans in Commet with automatic billing when the trial ends.
    - [Introductory Offers](https://commet.co/docs/introductory-offers.md): Configure automatic discounts on the first billing cycles for new customers in Commet.
  - Subscriptions: Manage subscription lifecycle, upgrades, and downgrades
    - [Manage Subscriptions](https://commet.co/docs/manage-subscriptions.md): Manage the complete lifecycle of customer subscriptions.
    - [Upgrade and Downgrade Plans](https://commet.co/docs/upgrade-and-downgrade-plans.md): How customers change plans through the Customer Portal and dashboard.
  - Usage: Track metered usage, AI tokens, and seat-based licenses
    - [Track Usage](https://commet.co/docs/track-usage.md): Track consumption events for metered features with the Commet SDK.
    - [AI Token Billing](https://commet.co/docs/ai-token-billing.md): Automatically measure and charge for AI token usage with model-aware pricing and configurable margins.
    - [Seat Management](https://commet.co/docs/seat-management.md): Manage seat-based licenses with the Commet SDK.
    - [Quota Management](https://commet.co/docs/quota-management.md): Manage durable quota balances with the Commet SDK.
  - Invoicing: Invoice generation, billing cycles, and payment failure handling
    - [Invoices and Billing Cycles](https://commet.co/docs/invoices-and-billing-cycles.md): How Commet generates invoices, what they contain, and when customers are charged.
    - [Handle Failed Payments](https://commet.co/docs/handle-failed-payments.md): What happens when a customer's payment fails and how they can reactivate from the Customer Portal.
  - Payments: Accept one-time payments with no subscription or plan
    - [Accept One-Time Payments](https://commet.co/docs/accept-one-time-payments.md): Charge customers once with the Commet payments resource — no subscription or plan required. Tax, invoice, and receipt handled automatically.
  - Finance: Payouts, account verification, and Merchant of Record
    - [Finance Overview](https://commet.co/docs/finance-overview.md): How money flows through Commet — balances, payouts, and transaction history.
    - [Request a Payout to Your Bank](https://commet.co/docs/payouts.md): Withdraw your available Commet balance to your bank account — $10 minimum, arrives in 3-5 business days.
    - [Account Verification](https://commet.co/docs/payouts-verification.md): How to get verified for payouts — KYC process with Stripe.
    - [Supported Countries](https://commet.co/docs/supported-countries.md): Countries where Commet supports payouts and business operations.
    - [Merchant of Record](https://commet.co/docs/merchant-of-record.md): What a Merchant of Record is and how Commet handles taxes, compliance, refunds, and payouts on your behalf.
    - [Acceptable Use Policy](https://commet.co/docs/acceptable-use.md): What products and services can be sold through Commet.

  - [Billing Intervals](https://commet.co/docs/how-do-monthly-quarterly-and-yearly-billing-work.md): How weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly billing works and when your customers get charged
  - [Invoices](https://commet.co/docs/what-invoices-do-customers-receive-and-when.md): What invoices your customers receive and when
  - [Proration](https://commet.co/docs/how-is-proration-calculated-when-changing-plans.md): Exactly how mid-cycle charges are calculated when your customer upgrades
  - [Trials](https://commet.co/docs/how-do-trial-periods-work.md): How trial periods work and what your customers experience
  - [Free Plans](https://commet.co/docs/how-do-free-plans-work-without-payment.md): How free plans work for your customers
  - [Payment Failures](https://commet.co/docs/what-happens-when-a-payment-fails.md): What happens when your customer's payment fails
  - [Seats](https://commet.co/docs/how-does-seat-based-billing-work.md): How seat-based billing works for your customers
  - [Quota](https://commet.co/docs/how-does-quota-based-billing-work.md): How quota-based billing works for your customers
  - [Discounts](https://commet.co/docs/how-do-discounts-work.md): How introductory offers and promo codes interact and what your customers experience

- API Reference: Complete REST API reference for the Commet platform
  - Add ons
    - [Activate add-on](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/add-ons/activate-addon.md): Activate an add-on on a subscription. Charges a prorated amount for the current billing period.
    - [Create add-on](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/add-ons/create-addon.md): Create a new add-on linked to a feature. Each feature can only be assigned to one add-on.
    - [Deactivate add-on](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/add-ons/deactivate-addon.md): Deactivate an add-on from a subscription.
    - [Delete add-on](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/add-ons/delete-addon.md): Soft-delete an add-on. Fails if the add-on has active subscriptions.
    - [Get add-on](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/add-ons/get-addon.md): Retrieve an add-on by its public ID or slug.
    - [List active add-ons](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/add-ons/list-active-addons.md): List all active add-ons for a customer's subscription.
    - [List add-ons](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/add-ons/list-addons.md): List all add-ons with cursor-based pagination.
    - [Update add-on](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/add-ons/update-addon.md): Update an add-on's name, description, or pricing.
  - Api keys
    - [Create API key](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/api-keys/create-api-key.md): Create a new API key. The full key is only returned once in the response.
    - [Delete API key](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/api-keys/delete-api-key.md): Permanently revoke and delete an API key.
    - [List API keys](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/api-keys/list-api-keys.md): List API keys with cursor-based pagination. Keys are returned without the full secret.
  - Credit packs
    - [Create credit pack](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/credit-packs/create-credit-pack.md): Create a new credit pack.
    - [Delete credit pack](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/credit-packs/delete-credit-pack.md): Soft-delete a credit pack.
    - [List credit packs](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/credit-packs/list-credit-packs.md): List all active credit packs.
    - [Purchase credits](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/credit-packs/purchase-credits.md): Purchase a credit pack for a subscription. Charges the customer and adds credits to their balance.
    - [Update credit pack](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/credit-packs/update-credit-pack.md): Update a credit pack's name, description, credits, price, or active status.
  - Customers
    - [Batch create customers](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/customers/batch-create-customers.md): Create up to 100 customers in a single request.
    - [Create customer](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/customers/create-customer.md): Create a new customer. Idempotent when customerId is provided.
    - [Get customer](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/customers/get-customer.md): Retrieve a customer by their public ID, including subscription status and metadata.
    - [List customers](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/customers/list-customers.md): List customers with cursor-based pagination.
    - [Update customer](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/customers/update-customer.md): Update a customer's name, external ID, or metadata.
  - Features
    - [Create feature](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/features/create-feature.md): Create a new feature. Code must be lowercase alphanumeric with underscores.
    - [Delete feature](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/features/delete-feature.md): Delete a feature. Fails if the feature is attached to active plans or has an active add-on.
    - [Get feature access](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/features/get-feature-access.md): Get feature access details for a customer. Use action=canUse to check if the customer can consume one more unit.
    - [Get feature](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/features/get-feature.md): Get a single feature definition by code from the organization's feature catalog.
    - [List feature access](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/features/list-feature-access.md): List all features for a customer's active subscription, scoped by the customerId query parameter.
    - [List features](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/features/list-features.md): List every feature defined in the organization. This is the organization's feature catalog (definitions), not a customer's feature access.
    - [Update feature](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/features/update-feature.md): Update a feature's name, description, or unit name. At least one field must be provided.
  - Invoices
    - [Create adjustment invoice](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/invoices/create-adjustment-invoice.md): Create a one-off adjustment invoice. Use a negative amount for a credit.
    - [Download invoice PDF](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/invoices/download-invoice.md): Generate a signed URL to download the invoice as a PDF. The URL expires after 7 days.
    - [Get invoice](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/invoices/get-invoice.md): Retrieve a single invoice by its public ID, including line items.
    - [List invoices](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/invoices/list-invoices.md): List invoices with cursor-based pagination. Filter by customer, status, or subscription.
    - [Send invoice email](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/invoices/send-invoice.md): Send the invoice to the customer via email.
    - [Update invoice status](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/invoices/update-invoice-status.md): Mark an outstanding invoice as "paid" or "void". Cannot change the status of already paid or voided invoices.
  - Payments
    - [Cancel a payment link](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/payments/cancel-payment.md): Cancel a pending payment link so it can no longer be paid. Only a link that has not been paid or started processing can be canceled; canceling an already canceled link is a no-op. Charges cannot be canceled.
    - [Charge a customer](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/payments/charge-payment.md): Charge a customer's vaulted payment method off-session. Calculates tax, generates an invoice, and sends a receipt. No subscription or plan required.
    - [Create a payment link](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/payments/create-payment.md): Create a hosted payment link. Returns a url the customer opens to pay with any card. Calculates tax, generates an invoice, and vaults the payment method on confirmation. No subscription or plan required.
    - [Get payment](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/payments/get-payment.md): Retrieve a payment by its public ID.
    - [List payments](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/payments/list-payments.md): List payments with cursor-based pagination. Filter by customer.
  - Payouts
    - [Add a payout bank account](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/payouts/add-payout-bank-account.md): Add an additional destination bank account to the organization's existing payout account. Country and currency are resolved from the organization. The full account number is never returned — only `last4`.
    - [Complete payout verification](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/payouts/complete-payout-verification.md): Provision the organization's payout account in a single call with the full KYC + bank payload. Uploads the identity document, persists the destination bank, and creates the connected account through the org's payout provider. The account starts `pending_verification` and flips to `verified` via the provider's webhook. Idempotent: returns the existing account if the org already has one.
    - [Request a payout](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/payouts/request-payout.md): Withdraw available balance to the organization's verified payout account. `amount` is in cents (USD, minimum 1000 = $10). The payout is created in `pending` and settles to `paid` asynchronously as provider webhooks arrive.
  - Plan groups
    - [Add plan to group](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/plan-groups/add-plan-to-group.md): Add an existing plan to a plan group with optional sort order.
    - [Create plan group](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/plan-groups/create-plan-group.md): Create a new plan group for organizing plans.
    - [Delete plan group](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/plan-groups/delete-plan-group.md): Delete a plan group. Plans in the group are unlinked, not deleted.
    - [Get plan group](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/plan-groups/get-plan-group.md): Retrieve a plan group by ID, including its plans ordered by sortOrder.
    - [List plan groups](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/plan-groups/list-plan-groups.md): List plan groups with cursor-based pagination.
    - [Remove plan from group](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/plan-groups/remove-plan-from-group.md): Remove a plan from a plan group.
    - [Reorder plans in group](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/plan-groups/reorder-plans-in-group.md): Set the display order of plans within a group. All plan IDs in the group must be provided.
    - [Update plan group](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/plan-groups/update-plan-group.md): Update a plan group's name, description, or visibility.
  - Plans
    - [Add feature to plan](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/plans/add-plan-feature.md): Attach a feature to a plan with limits, overage, and credits configuration.
    - [Add price to plan](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/plans/add-plan-price.md): Add a billing interval price to a plan with optional trial days and included balance/credits.
    - [Create plan](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/plans/create-plan.md): Create a new plan with optional consumption model, visibility, and plan group assignment.
    - [Delete plan price](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/plans/delete-plan-price.md): Remove a price from a plan.
    - [Delete plan](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/plans/delete-plan.md): Soft-delete a plan.
    - [Delete regional prices](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/plans/delete-regional-prices.md): Remove all regional currency overrides for a plan price.
    - [Get plan](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/plans/get-plan.md): Get detailed plan information by code or ID.
    - [List plans](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/plans/list-plans.md): List all plans with their prices and features. Optionally include private plans.
    - [Remove feature from plan](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/plans/remove-plan-feature.md): Detach a feature from a plan.
    - [Set default price](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/plans/set-default-plan-price.md): Set a specific price as the default for its plan. Unsets previous default.
    - [Set plan regional pricing](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/plans/set-plan-regional-pricing.md): Configure a plan's regional pricing for one currency. Sending only currency and exchangeRate derives every regional value (base price, included balance, feature overage, intro offer) from the USD value at that rate. Optional per-price and per-feature overrides are stored as manual values.
    - [Set plan visibility](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/plans/set-plan-visibility.md): Toggle a plan between public and private.
    - [Update plan feature](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/plans/update-plan-feature.md): Update limits, overage, or enabled status of a feature on a plan.
    - [Update plan price](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/plans/update-plan-price.md): Update an existing price on a plan.
    - [Update plan](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/plans/update-plan.md): Update a plan's name, description, visibility, or metadata.
    - [Upsert regional prices](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/plans/upsert-regional-prices.md): Create or update regional currency price overrides for a plan price.
  - Portal
    - [Request portal access](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/portal/request-portal-access.md): Generate a customer portal URL. Exactly one identifier (email or customerId) is required.
  - Promo codes
    - [Create promo code](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/promo-codes/create-promo-code.md): Create a new promo code. Optionally restrict to specific plans.

**100% discounts are not supported.** Percentage codes must be strictly less than 100% (`discountValue` < 10000 basis points). For full waivers, use an introductory offer on the plan instead. At checkout, any code — percentage or fixed amount — that would reduce the total below the currency's minimum charge ($0.50 USD equivalent) is silently dropped.
    - [Get promo code](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/promo-codes/get-promo-code.md): Retrieve a promo code by its public ID.
    - [List promo codes](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/promo-codes/list-promo-codes.md): List promo codes with cursor-based pagination.
    - [Update promo code](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/promo-codes/update-promo-code.md): Update a promo code's redemption limits, expiration, active status, or plan restrictions.
  - Quota
    - [Add quota](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/quota/add-quota.md): Add to a customer's quota allowance for a feature. Defaults to 1 if count is omitted.
    - [List quota allowances](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/quota/get-all-quota-allowances.md): Get all quota allowances for a customer across every quota feature in their plan.
    - [Get quota allowance](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/quota/get-quota-allowance.md): Get the current quota allowance (used vs included) for a specific feature.
    - [Remove quota](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/quota/remove-quota.md): Remove from a customer's quota allowance for a feature. Defaults to 1 if count is omitted. Returns 400 insufficient_balance if the balance would go negative.
    - [Set quota](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/quota/set-quota.md): Set a customer's quota allowance for a feature to an exact value.
  - Seats
    - [Add seats](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/seats/add-seats.md): Add seats to a customer's subscription. Prorates charges for the current billing period.
    - [Bulk set seats](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/seats/bulk-set-seats.md): Set all seat types at once.
    - [Get all seat balances](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/seats/get-all-seat-balances.md): Get the current balance for all seat types in a customer's subscription.
    - [Get seat balance](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/seats/get-seat-balance.md): Get current balance for a specific seat type.
    - [Remove seats](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/seats/remove-seats.md): Remove seats from a customer's subscription. Takes effect at the end of the billing period.
    - [Set seats](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/seats/set-seats.md): Set seats to an exact count.
  - Subscriptions
    - [Adjust balance](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/subscriptions/adjust-balance.md): Adjust a subscription's balance or credits by a signed amount. Positive adds, negative subtracts.
    - [Cancel subscription](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/subscriptions/cancel-subscription.md): Cancel immediately or at period end.
    - [Change plan](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/subscriptions/change-plan.md): Upgrade, downgrade, or change billing interval.
    - [Create a recovery payment link for a past due subscription](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/subscriptions/create-subscription-recovery-link.md): Generates a hosted, signed recovery link that lets the customer pay the outstanding renewal charge for a past_due subscription. Unlike reactivate, which charges server-to-server, this returns a link the merchant can deliver through their own email, SMS, or dashboard. The link carries a self-contained signed token and stays valid until the charge is paid or the subscription is no longer past due.
    - [Create subscription](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/subscriptions/create-subscription.md): Create a subscription for a customer. Requires planId or planCode plus customerId.
    - [Get active subscription](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/subscriptions/get-active-subscription.md): Get the active subscription for a customer. Returns null if none.
    - [Get subscription by ID](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/subscriptions/get-subscription.md): Get a subscription by its public ID, regardless of status (including pending_payment and past_due).
    - [List subscriptions](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/subscriptions/list-subscriptions.md): List all subscriptions. Filter by customer ID or status.
    - [Preview plan change](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/subscriptions/preview-change-plan.md): Preview proration details for an immediate plan change (an upgrade or a longer interval) without applying it. Returns credit, charge, and net amount. Downgrades — a cheaper plan in the same group, or a shorter interval — are scheduled for the end of the current period instead of being prorated, so they return a 400 with code `plan_change_scheduled`; apply those via the change-plan endpoint.
    - [Reactivate a past due or canceled subscription](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/subscriptions/reactivate-subscription.md): Reactivates a subscription. A past_due subscription retries its outstanding renewal charge (recovering to active on success). A canceled subscription generates a fresh invoice, charges the saved card, and resets the billing period. On a successful charge the subscription becomes active; a declined charge returns an error with a recoveryUrl in the error details that can be sent to the customer to update their card.
    - [Top up balance](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/subscriptions/topup-balance.md): Top up a subscription's balance. Charges the customer's payment method for the specified amount.
    - [Revert scheduled cancellation](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/subscriptions/uncancel-subscription.md): Revert a scheduled cancellation. Only works when canceledAt is set but status is not yet 'canceled'.
    - [Update payment method](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/subscriptions/update-payment-method.md): Creates a hosted checkout session for the customer to update the subscription's default payment method.
  - Test clock
    - [Advance test clock](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/test-clock/advance-test-clock.md): Moves the test clock forward, by a number of days (advanceDays) or to an absolute instant (frozenTime). The clock can only move forward. Sandbox only.
    - [Get test clock state](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/test-clock/get-test-clock.md): Returns the organization's current test clock state. Sandbox only.
    - [Process pending billing](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/test-clock/process-test-clock-billing.md): Discovers customers due for billing at the org's current (simulated) time and enqueues a billing cycle for each — renewals, expired trials, pending cancellations. Enqueueing is asynchronous. Sandbox only.
  - Transactions
    - [Get transaction](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/transactions/get-transaction.md): Retrieve a single payment transaction by its public ID, including provider details.
    - [List transactions](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/transactions/list-transactions.md): List payment transactions with cursor-based pagination. Filter by status or customer email.
    - [Refund transaction](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/transactions/refund-transaction.md): Issue a full refund for a payment transaction.
    - [Retry transaction](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/transactions/retry-transaction.md): Retry a failed subscription renewal. Re-charges the outstanding renewal invoice through the recovery engine.
  - Usage
    - [Check usage availability](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/usage/check-usage-availability.md): Check if a customer can consume a feature before actual consumption. Returns availability and cost estimates based on the plan's consumption model.
    - [Track usage event](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/usage/track-usage-event.md): Track a usage event for a metered feature. Deducts from balance/credits if applicable.
  - Webhooks
    - [Create webhook endpoint](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/webhooks/create-webhook-endpoint.md): Create a new webhook endpoint. The response includes the signing secret which is only returned once.
    - [Delete webhook endpoint](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/webhooks/delete-webhook-endpoint.md): Permanently delete a webhook endpoint.
    - [Get webhook endpoint](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/webhooks/get-webhook-endpoint.md): Retrieve a webhook endpoint by its public ID.
    - [List webhook endpoints](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/webhooks/list-webhook-endpoints.md): List webhook endpoints with cursor-based pagination.
    - [Test webhook endpoint](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/webhooks/test-webhook-endpoint.md): Send a test event to a webhook endpoint to verify connectivity.
    - [Update webhook endpoint](https://commet.co/docs/api-reference/webhooks/update-webhook-endpoint.md): Update a webhook endpoint. Only the provided fields change.
- Webhooks: Real-time event notifications for subscription, payment, and invoice changes
  - [Introduction](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/introduction.md): Receive real-time notifications when events happen in your Commet account.

  - **Subscription Events**
  - [subscription.created](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/subscription-created.md): Fired when a new subscription is created
  - [subscription.activated](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/subscription-activated.md): Fired when a subscription becomes active after payment
  - [subscription.reactivated](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/subscription-reactivated.md): Fired when a canceled subscription is reactivated and its reactivation charge succeeds.
  - [subscription.canceled](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/subscription-canceled.md): Fired when a subscription is terminated at the end of the billing period. Revoke access here.
  - [subscription.updated](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/subscription-updated.md): Fired when subscription details change, including when a cancellation is scheduled.
  - [subscription.plan_changed](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/subscription-plan-changed.md): Fired when a subscription changes plans
  - [subscription.cancellation_scheduled](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/subscription-cancellation-scheduled.md): Fired when a cancellation is scheduled for the end of the billing period. Do NOT revoke access yet.
  - [subscription.cancellation_revoked](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/subscription-cancellation-revoked.md): Fired when a scheduled cancellation is reverted before it executes. The subscription continues normally.
  - [subscription.plan_change_scheduled](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/subscription-plan-change-scheduled.md): Fired when a downgrade or interval change is scheduled for the end of the billing period.
  - [subscription.plan_change_revoked](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/subscription-plan-change-revoked.md): Fired when a scheduled plan change is replaced before it executes.
  - [subscription.past_due](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/subscription-past-due.md): Fired when a recurring payment fails and the subscription enters a grace window while Commet retries the charge.

  - **Trial Events**
  - [trial.started](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/trial-started.md): Fired when a subscription enters its trial period. Grant access here.
  - [trial.converted](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/trial-converted.md): Fired when a trialing customer converts to a paid subscription before the trial ends.
  - [trial.expired](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/trial-expired.md): Fired when a trial period runs out and regular billing begins.
  - [trial.will_end](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/trial-will-end.md): Predictive event fired once, 3 days before a trial ends.
  - [trial.checkout_ready](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/trial-checkout-ready.md): A trial checkout link is ready to share with the customer.

  - **Checkout Events**
  - [checkout.ready](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/checkout-ready.md): A checkout link is ready to share with the customer.

  - **Payment Events**
  - [payment.received](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/payment-received.md): Fired when a recurring payment is processed
  - [payment.failed](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/payment-failed.md): Fired when a recurring charge fails
  - [payment.recovered](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/payment-recovered.md): A previously failed payment was recovered.
  - [payment.refunded](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/payment-refunded.md): A payment was refunded to the customer.
  - [payment.disputed](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/payment-disputed.md): A customer opened a dispute against a payment.
  - [payment.dispute_resolved](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/payment-dispute-resolved.md): A payment dispute was resolved as won or lost.

  - **Payment Link Events**
  - [payment_link.created](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/payment-link-created.md): A payment link was created and is ready to be paid.
  - [payment_link.completed](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/payment-link-completed.md): A payment link was paid successfully.
  - [payment_link.failed](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/payment-link-failed.md): A payment link charge attempt failed.
  - [payment_link.canceled](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/payment-link-canceled.md): A payment link was canceled before being paid.

  - **Invoice Events**
  - [invoice.created](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/invoice-created.md): Fired when a new invoice is generated
  - [invoice.upcoming](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/invoice-upcoming.md): Predictive event fired once, 3 days before a subscription renews.
  - [invoice.overdue](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/invoice-overdue.md): An outstanding invoice passed its due date without payment.
  - [invoice.voided](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/invoice-voided.md): An invoice was voided and will not be collected.

  - **Payment Method Events**
  - [payment_method.attached](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/payment-method-attached.md): A payment method was saved for a customer's subscription.
  - [payment_method.updated](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/payment-method-updated.md): A customer's default payment method was replaced.

  - **Customer Events**
  - [customer.created](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/customer-created.md): Fired when a customer is created. The payload mirrors the customer resource from GET /customers.
  - [customer.updated](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/customer-updated.md): Fired when a customer's details change. Carries the full current customer resource.
  - [customer.state_changed](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/customer-state-changed.md): Aggregate entitlement event — what can this customer access right now.

  - **Credits & Balance Events**
  - [credits.granted](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/credits-granted.md): Non-purchase credits were granted to a subscription.
  - [credits.purchased](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/credits-purchased.md): A credit pack purchase was completed.
  - [credits.low](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/credits-low.md): Remaining credits dropped below 10% of the period grant.
  - [credits.depleted](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/credits-depleted.md): A subscription ran out of credits.
  - [credits.expired](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/credits-expired.md): Unused plan credits expired at the period reset.
  - [balance.topped_up](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/balance-topped-up.md): A prepaid balance top-up was completed.
  - [balance.low](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/balance-low.md): Prepaid balance dropped below 10% of the last refill.
  - [balance.depleted](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/balance-depleted.md): A subscription ran out of prepaid balance.

  - **Quota & Usage Events**
  - [quota.threshold_reached](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/quota-threshold-reached.md): Usage crossed 80% of a feature's included quantity.
  - [quota.exceeded](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/quota-exceeded.md): Usage passed a feature's included quantity.
  - [usage.recorded](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/usage-recorded.md): A usage event was recorded. High volume — explicit opt-in.

  - **Seat Events**
  - [seats.updated](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/seats-updated.md): A customer's seat count changed.
  - [seats.limit_reached](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/seats-limit-reached.md): A seat change reached the plan's included seat limit.

  - **Add-on Events**
  - [addon.activated](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/addon-activated.md): An add-on was activated on a subscription.
  - [addon.deactivated](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/addon-deactivated.md): An add-on was deactivated from a subscription.

  - **Payout Events**
  - [payout.available](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/payout-available.md): Funds became available to pay out to your bank.
  - [payout.created](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/payout-created.md): A payout to your bank account was initiated.
  - [payout.paid](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/payout-paid.md): A payout landed in your bank account.
  - [payout.failed](https://commet.co/docs/webhooks/payout-failed.md): A payout to your bank account failed.
